Please note that [the Svelte codebase is currently being rewritten for Svelte 5](https://svelte.dev/blog/runes). Changes should target Svelte 5, which lives on the default branch (`main`).

- [x] Prefix your PR title with `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, or `docs:`.
- [x] This message body should clearly illustrate what problems it solves.
- [x] Ideally, include a test that fails without this PR but passes with it.

issue_context.title: Migrate to `$state` instead of `run`
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

`$: showingHiddenPeople = false;` is migrated to:
```
  let showingHiddenPeople;
  run(() => {
    showingHiddenPeople = false;
  });
```

### Reproduction

https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/a019fb670e0c1edfea24cd6620e4eaecf54a0600/web/src/lib/components/asset-viewer/detail-panel.svelte#L100

### Logs

_No response_

### System Info

```shell
svelte 5 as of sep 30
```


### Severity

annoyance
comments: A side note: the `run()` function doesn't seem to be documented anywhere, is that the case?

> A side note: the `run()` function doesn't seem to be documented anywhere, is that the case?

That's just for the legacy migration...it will probably have some doc once we have proper documentation in place tho but since it shouldn't be used outside of the migration I don't think it actually needs too much docs
I've checked and it is in the new docs for Svelte 5. They're not available yet, but the function will be covered by docs
